From: Greg Kroah-Hartman <[email]>

Description
===========

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

KVM: SVM: Inject #UD for INVLPGA if EFER.SVME=0

INVLPGA should cause a #UD when EFER.SVME is not set. Add a check to
properly inject #UD when EFER.SVME=0.

[sean: tag for stable@]

The Linux kernel CVE team has assigned CVE-2026-46082 to this issue.

Affected and fixed versions
===========================

	Issue introduced in 2.6.32 with commit ff092385e8285c03d8b148f42f46f98c5f4becd5 and fixed in 6.6.140 with commit 3ac9d4241d205f5d0df06358349ca718ebb0fa12
	Issue introduced in 2.6.32 with commit ff092385e8285c03d8b148f42f46f98c5f4becd5 and fixed in 6.12.86 with commit 643125b66ffc1147c66616b749475ba9efb15971
	Issue introduced in 2.6.32 with commit ff092385e8285c03d8b148f42f46f98c5f4becd5 and fixed in 6.18.27 with commit c15392ed9e49c1a16b4d3a3ccf1b3bf2318a6c28
	Issue introduced in 2.6.32 with commit ff092385e8285c03d8b148f42f46f98c5f4becd5 and fixed in 7.0.4 with commit ee24928ecd85db4b68ed111e91fef36af0ca37b0
	Issue introduced in 2.6.32 with commit ff092385e8285c03d8b148f42f46f98c5f4becd5 and fixed in 7.1-rc1 with commit d99df02ff427f461102230f9c5b90a6c64ee8e23

Please see https://www.kernel.org for a full list of currently supported
kernel versions by the kernel community.

Unaffected versions might change over time as fixes are backported to
older supported kernel versions.  The official CVE entry at
	https://cve.org/CVERecord/?id=CVE-2026-46082
will be updated if fixes are backported, please check that for the most
up to date information about this issue.

Affected files
==============

The file(s) affected by this issue are:
	arch/x86/kvm/svm/svm.c

Mitigation
==========

The Linux kernel CVE team recommends that you update to the latest
stable kernel version for this, and many other bugfixes.  Individual
changes are never tested alone, but rather are part of a larger kernel
release.  Cherry-picking individual commits is not recommended or
supported by the Linux kernel community at all.  If however, updating to
the latest release is impossible, the individual changes to resolve this
issue can be found at these commits:
	https://git.kernel.org/stable/c/3ac9d4241d205f5d0df06358349ca718ebb0fa12
